description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he expects KaVontae Turpin to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Turpin will be on the practice field to begin the week, a good sign for his status heading into Week 10.
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) expected to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he expects DeMarvion Overshown to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Overshown will be on the practice field to begin the week, a good sign for his status heading into Week 10.
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown expected to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he expects Joey Porter Jr. to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Porter will be on the practice field to begin the week, a good sign for his status heading into Week 10.
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) expected to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he expects George Pickens to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pickens was ruled out last week for Dallas. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his return.
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) expected to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers opened the practice window of RB Jonathon Brooks.
items.impact: Brooks will have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens worked out free agent kicker Harrison Mevis.
items.impact: Mevis was released by the Rams. He will compete for the opportunity to kick for Baltimore.
items.title: Harrison Mevis works out for Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens worked out free agent kicker Riley Patterson.
items.impact: Patterson was released by the Dolphins. He will compete for the opportunity to kick for Baltimore.
items.title: Riley Patterson works out for Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Will Lee III is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lee is on track to have a chance to play this week for the Panthers.
items.title: Will Lee III (hamstring) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Damien Lewis is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lewis was sidelined last week for the Panthers. His presence in practice to begin the week is a positive sign for his return.
items.title: Damien Lewis (knee) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he's hopeful Skyy Moore will practice this week.
items.impact: Moore has missed the last four with an ankle injury.
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) to practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he's hopeful Zaire Franklin will practice this week.
items.impact: Franklin has missed the last three games with a shin injury.
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) hopeful to practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Micah Parsons will not practice on Wednesday due to an illness.
items.impact: Parsons will be hopeful to return to practice on Thursday. He had his practice window opened last week.
items.title: Micah Parsons not practicing Wednesday due to illness

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said there is a chance that center Sean Rhyan could return this week.
items.impact: Rhyan was expected to avoid injured reserve. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) could return in Week 10

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cade Mays has an "outside shot of playing this week."
items.impact: Mays continues to battle an ankle injury. It appears he is trending the wrong direction this week.
items.title: Cade Mays (ankle) uncertain for Week 10

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. has an "outside shot of playing this week."
items.impact: Reed continues to battle a hip injury. It appears he is trending the wrong direction this week.
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) uncertain for Week 10

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Wonnum will return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wonnum has cleared an obstacle to return to action. He remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: DJ Wonnum (concussion) to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Peter Woods will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Woods remains day-to-day with a neck stinger.
items.title: Peter Woods (neck stinger) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Jaylon Moore will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore was considered day-to-day to begin the week. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.
items.title: Jaylon Moore (ankle) will not practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said he expects Xavier Worthy to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Reid added that Worthy was "feeling pretty good" as he battles a hamstring injury.
items.title: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) expected to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said he anticipates Patrick Mahomes II will practice in full on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mahomes was day-to-day to start the week. Reid added that Mahomes was throwing the ball well despite his elbow injury.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) expected to practice in full Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers RB Josh Jacobs could return in 2-to-3 weeks.
items.impact: Jacobs will have surgery later this week on his broken ring finger. The Packers will decide on Saturday if an IR stint is necessary.
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) could return in 2-to-3 weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Trey Burks is in good shape to play against the Giants on Thursday.
items.impact: Burks did not play last week for Washington. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) 'in good shape' to play Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Harrison Butker will remain the Chiefs kicker in Week 10 against the Falcons.
items.impact: Butker continues to struggle on the season with another missed field goal.
items.title: Harrison Butker to remain Chiefs kicker in Week 10

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hawkins is back on the field after a mini bye for Baltimore. He did not play last Thursday for the Ravens.
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hamilton was on the practice field off the mini bye for Baltimore. He'll have an extra day to practice with the Ravens playing on Monday.
items.title: Kyle Hamilton (hip) practices Wednesday
